knowledge_nuggets.title: Dependency Injection
knowledge_nuggets.content: DI (like Hilt) helps in making code modular, testable, and reusable by providing dependencies from outside.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Solid Principles
knowledge_nuggets.content: 5 principles (Single Responsibility, Open-Closed, etc.) that make software designs more understandable and flexible.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Room Migration
knowledge_nuggets.content: When changing DB schema, Room migrations ensure user data is preserved while updating the database structure.

knowledge_nuggets.title: ViewModel Lifecycle
knowledge_nuggets.content: ViewModels survive configuration changes (like rotation), ensuring UI data isn't lost during activity recreation.

knowledge_nuggets.title: StateFlow vs SharedFlow
knowledge_nuggets.content: StateFlow is for state (has a value), SharedFlow is for events (one-time actions like snackbars).

knowledge_nuggets.title: Color Psychology
knowledge_nuggets.content: Blue builds trust, Red creates urgency. Choose colors based on the emotion you want users to feel.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Rule of Thirds
knowledge_nuggets.content: Place important elements at the intersections of a 3x3 grid to create balance and focus.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Visual Hierarchy
knowledge_nuggets.content: Use size, color, and contrast to guide the user's eye to the most important content first.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Micro-interactions
knowledge_nuggets.content: Small animations (like a button bounce) that provide feedback and make the app feel alive.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Negative Space
knowledge_nuggets.content: Whitespace is not empty; it's a powerful tool to reduce clutter and increase readability.

knowledge_nuggets.title: RESTful APIs
knowledge_nuggets.content: A standard way for clients and servers to communicate using HTTP methods like GET, POST, PUT, DELETE.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Database Indexing
knowledge_nuggets.content: Indexing speeds up data retrieval but slows down writes. Use it on columns frequently used in queries.

knowledge_nuggets.title: JWT Auth
knowledge_nuggets.content: JSON Web Tokens provide a stateless way to handle authentication between client and server.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Microservices
knowledge_nuggets.content: Breaking a large app into smaller, independent services that communicate over a network.

knowledge_nuggets.title: ACID Properties
knowledge_nuggets.content: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability: the gold standard for reliable database transactions.

career_paths.title: Professional Growth
career_paths.description: Essential skills for a successful career.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Effective Comm.
knowledge_nuggets.content: Clear communication is about listening as much as speaking. Always confirm understanding with feedback.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Time Blocking
knowledge_nuggets.content: Schedule specific blocks of time for deep work to avoid distractions and increase productivity.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Imposter Syndrome
knowledge_nuggets.content: Even experts feel like frauds sometimes. Focus on your growth and facts rather than feelings.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Networking
knowledge_nuggets.content: Build relationships before you need them. Help others first, and your network will grow naturally.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Critical Thinking
knowledge_nuggets.content: Don't just solve the problem; ask why the problem exists in the first place to find better solutions.
